萧义士: gallant Mr Xiao, honorific address to Xiao Jiaji
遗折/遗疏: final memorial to the throne; held in safekeeping unless Hangzhou falls and Wang dies
第二章末行动状态: Rice arrived four days earlier; Wang learned yesterday; morning attack failed. Xiao proposes another three days’ wait and promises conditional foreign-troop support. Wang’s 20,000-tael reward is conditional on relief succeeding and remains unpaid.
伍子胥: Wu Zixu; literary association with the Qiantang tides retained
